step_by_step_reasoning:
The architecture illustrates an automated AWS Migration Factory solution designed to migrate workloads from on-premises to AWS in minutes.

1. Initial Setup & Metadata Collection:
   - Migration Team enters target account operational metadata (tags, IP addresses, subnets, RTO/RPO) into Amazon DynamoDB.
   - On-premises servers run AWS Application Discovery Service agents to send network (TCP connections) and performance metrics to AWS Application Discovery Service.
   - On-premises servers also continuously replicate block-level volume data to an EC2 Hot Replica staging instance in AWS via CloudEndure.

2. Migration Trigger & Orchestration:
   - The Migration Team issues a single command via Slack to trigger the migration process.
   - Slack calls an API on the central EC2 Migration Factory instance.
   - The EC2 Migration Factory queries Application Discovery Service for inbound/outbound connection metadata.
   - EC2 Migration Factory reads operational and tagging metadata from DynamoDB.
   - EC2 Migration Factory calls CloudEndure API to stop block replication on the EC2 Hot Replica.
   - CloudEndure stops replication on the EC2 Hot Replica.
   - EC2 Migration Factory bakes an AMI from the staging replica (Bake AMI).
   - EC2 Migration Factory shares the encrypted AMI across account boundaries to the Target Account (Shared AMI).
   - EC2 Migration Factory launches and configures the final EC2 target instance in the Target Account applying all network, firewall, and metadata tags.

graph.name: Versent Automated Migration Factory Architecture
graph.notes: Automated migration factory pipeline using CloudEndure, Application Discovery Service, DynamoDB, Slack, and EC2 to orchestrate fast, 10-minute server migrations into AWS target accounts.

nodes.name: MIGRATION TEAM
nodes.notes: Operations and migration team initiating and configuring migration runs.

nodes.name: SLACK
nodes.notes: ChatOps interface used to trigger migration commands via API call.

nodes.name: ON-PREM
nodes.notes: On-premises source servers being migrated to AWS.

nodes.name: APP DISCOVERY SERVICE
nodes.notes: Collects inbound/outbound TCP connections and utilization data from on-premises servers.

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: Stores target account metadata, subnet, IP addresses, RTO/RPO, and EC2 tags (~10 tags per instance).

nodes.name: EC2 (Migration Factory)
nodes.notes: Central orchestrator running API integrations to coordinate discovery, CloudEndure, AMI baking, and deployment.

nodes.name: CLOUDENDURE
nodes.notes: Manages continuous block-level volume replication from on-premises to AWS.

nodes.name: EC2 HOT REPLICA
nodes.notes: Staging instance in AWS receiving continuous live block replication.

nodes.name: BAKE AMI
nodes.notes: Amazon Machine Image created from the hot replica staging disk.

nodes.name: SHARED AMI
nodes.notes: Encrypted AMI shared across account boundaries into the destination target account.

nodes.name: EC2 (Target Account)
nodes.notes: Final production instance launched in target AWS account with populated sizing, IP, and tags.
